1.why: Every MFA endpoint calls authenticated()/accountRecord(), which derive the account solely from the server-side session (session.userId === ACCOUNT_ID), and manipulated() rejects any body containing client-supplied userId/accountId keys.

2.why: Identity codes are stored per-session (session.identityCode) and compared with a constant-time check, so a code cannot be replayed by another session/user — only the non-production evaluation mode's fixed 111111 code is shared, and there is a single hard-coded account.

3.why: Sessions are only rotated at sign-in/identity verification and deleted on logout or timeout; /api/mfa/confirm does not invalidate any other existing sessions for the account, so previously established sessions remain valid after enrolment.

4.why: The TOTP seed is stored as AES-GCM ciphertext (encryptAtRest) and recovery codes are stored only as per-code salted SHA-256 digests, never plaintext.

5.why: All secrets, session ids, CSRF tokens, salts, nonces, OTP digits and base32 seeds come from crypto.getRandomValues via randomBytes (only a negligible modulo bias).

6.why: No localStorage/sessionStorage is used and the session cookie is __Host- prefixed with HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict — though CSRF token lives in JS memory and evaluation mode console-logs secrets/OTPs.

7.why: Server-side allow-list validators (email, phone, otp, secret, recovery, text length caps, JSON content-type check) constrain every input, and there is no SQL/database layer to inject into.

8.why: Rendered values pass through escapeHTML and only contain server-validated charset values; the escape map has a bug mapping '<' to '>', which is incorrect encoding but still prevents markup/script execution.

9.why: The application performs no redirects at all (no Location headers, no location assignments), so no open-redirect path exists, though there is likewise no explicit allow-list implementation.

10.why: headers() sets a strict nonce-based CSP with frame-ancestors 'none', HSTS with includeSubDomains, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy on all responses.

11.why: sessionCookie() emits `__Host-mfa_session=...; Path=/; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=...`.

12.why: Server never logs and returns only generic error messages with no stack traces or query-string secrets, but in the default (NODE_ENV unset) evaluation mode the API returns identity codes, TOTPs, seeds and recovery codes that the client console-logs.

13.why: Identity OTPs expire after 3 minutes and are cleared on use, enrolment drafts expire after 5 minutes and are marked used, and recovery codes are single-use (entry.used) and invalidated wholesale on regeneration.

14.why: Identity, draft-confirm, and recovery verification all increment failedAttempts and impose a 10-minute lockout after MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5, with identity lockout held at account level across sessions.

15.why: rotateSession() issues a new id and CSRF token at sign-in and at successful identity verification, getSession enforces 15-minute idle and 8-hour absolute timeouts, and /api/logout deletes the session and clears the cookie.
